sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: In Hungarian, the focus — the new or most important piece of information — sits right before the verb: *Harminc éves vagyok.*, *Budapesten lakom.* In questions, the question word takes that focus spot: *Hány éves vagy?*, *Hol laksz?*

Notice how the key detail in the answer (*Harminc éves*, *Budapesten*) lands right before *vagyok* or *lakom*, matching the spot where *Hány éves* or *Hol* sat in the question. Placing the emphasis right before the verb is the foundation of Hungarian word order.
